contract.title: Build RANKING_JUDGMENT_PACKET_MANIFEST.json: exact packet partition of the 50 tuning tasks (scripts/build-ranking-judgment-packets.mjs)
contract.invariant: Every tuning task is covered exactly once by RANKING_JUDGMENT_PACKET_MANIFEST.json; the packet partition derives from the sealed B9 tuning corpus (the 50 tuning tasks in the 6 tuning-split families of cross-repository-v3.manifest.json) and never includes any held-out task.
production_callers: scripts/ranking-v3-task-graph.mjs expand (C1G; consumes $PACKET_MANIFEST for graph expansion)
scripts/ranking-judgments.mjs verify-pool (C2.<packetId>; packet/task binding comes from the packet manifest)
evals/search-ranking/cross-repository-v3.manifest.json (source partition: 50 tuning tasks, 6 tuning families; 51 held-out tasks must be excluded)
interface_changes: scripts/build-ranking-judgment-packets.mjs (new CLI emitting RANKING_JUDGMENT_PACKET_MANIFEST.json; binds $PACKET_MANIFEST substitution authority)
security_boundaries: Tuning-only partitioning: the 51 held_out tasks of cross-repository-v3.manifest.json must never appear in any packet
Packet manifest binds task digests so packet agents cannot substitute or swap tasks
Held-out discipline: no held-out tasks, queries, captures, or outcomes enter packet design or construction
overlap_with: FT-G1 (C1G consumes C1's packet manifest via $PACKET_MANIFEST)
FT-B (B9 corpus binds the exact 50 tuning tasks that C1 partitions; capture digests flow through B6)
contract.instructions: Code-change card per §7.5 Wave C and §7.6 code-change table. focused_command targets the future test file scripts/build-ranking-judgment-packets.test.mjs which does NOT exist at round_base 652ec82c287fd3a05cc650f6a9eb51bf66bbbc18 — plan-specified, unverifiable-at-base; do not run at base. affected_command pnpm test:scripts is repo-verified (package.json) and will cover this test once created. §7.6 RED row: expected failure before implementation is 'missing or duplicate task appears'; minimal passing behavior is 'exact task partition is produced' — every one of the 50 tuning tasks appears in exactly one packet, zero held-out tasks appear. Prerequisites per §7.2: C1: DC0, A8, B9. Do not confuse the 6 tuning-split (LOFO) families (gitnexus, bookmark_ai_organizer, duas, vox_infinity, rpc_learner_engine, edge_tts_app — repositoryIds gitnexus-r0/bookmark-ai-organizer-r0/duas-r0/vox-infinity-r0/rpc-r0/edge-tts-app-r0, 50 tasks) with leakage.tuningOnlyRepositoryFamilies which has 11 entries including non-LOFO families. Output: RANKING_JUDGMENT_PACKET_MANIFEST.json (becomes $PACKET_MANIFEST).

contract.title: Wave-C graph expansion: write append-only TASK_GRAPH_EXPANSION_C.json via R1.T1 expand against the sealed template
contract.invariant: Packet IDs are the only post-seal graph expansion; expanded IDs must match the sealed template regex and may introduce only template-declared edges; TASK_GRAPH_EXPANSION_C.json is append-only and every packet appears exactly once.
owners: TASK_GRAPH_EXPANSION_C.json (expansion output; the expand tool is owned by R1.T1's scripts/ranking-v3-task-graph.mjs)
production_callers: scripts/ranking-v3-task-graph.mjs expand (R1.T1 tool invoked by C1G; validates against the sealed template with expansionAuthority c1_packet_manifest)
scripts/ranking-v3-dispatch-cards.mjs verify (DC1 card generator binds expansion receipts; every card generator validates base graph plus applicable expansion receipts)
test_callers: scripts/ranking-v3-task-graph.test.mjs (R1.T1 tool test, future; C1G relies on expand being seal-validated)
approved_files: $TASK_OUTPUT/TASK_GRAPH_EXPANSION_C.json (task output; no tracked source file exists at base — the tool is R1.T1-owned)
interface_changes: TASK_GRAPH_EXPANSION_C.json (via R1.T1 expand --graph --packet-manifest --out; expanded IDs must match the sealed template regex and introduce only template-declared edges)
security_boundaries: Post-seal expansion is the ONLY graph mutation allowed; cycles, unknown nodes, undeclared IDs, and unresolved hard dependencies block dispatch
Sealed template regex enforcement: expansion cannot introduce undeclared task IDs or held-out tasks (packet manifest is tuning-only)
Append-only expansion receipt: TASK_GRAPH_EXPANSION_C.json is never rewritten after emission
overlap_with: FT-G1 (C1G invokes R1.T1 expand against sealed templates)
contract.instructions: Evidence/execution card per §7.5 Wave C (output column 'graph expansion') and §7.6 evidence-card table. focused_command is the §7.5 exact command with plan substitution variables ($TASK_GRAPH, $PACKET_MANIFEST, $TASK_OUTPUT); scripts/ranking-v3-task-graph.mjs does NOT exist at round_base 652ec82c287fd3a05cc650f6a9eb51bf66bbbc18 (R1.T1 future file) — plan-specified, unverifiable-at-base; do not run at base. affected_command pnpm test:scripts is repo-verified (package.json) and only meaningfully covers this card after Gate 1 (R1.T1's scripts/ranking-v3-task-graph.test.mjs lands). §7.6 row: unmet precondition 'packet manifest from C1 receipt is absent'; validating assertion 'expansion IDs match template regex and every packet exactly once'. contract.title: Boundary-generator card DC1 (dispatch scope wave-c-expanded, next DD)
contract.invariant: DC1 binds the wave-boundary tree through the R0.1V-owned verifier, then invokes the one R0.1B-owned dispatch CLI with literals fixed by the boundary card; the card-set manifest (schemaVersion ranking_v3_dispatch_cards_v2) contains the target scope plus the next boundary-generator card DD; every card resolves to a §7.5/§7.6 catalog row; no executing agent chooses an argument or discovers a file.
approved_files: DC1: card-generation task; produces the card-set directory $CARD_SET_DIR only; no source file ownership
interface_changes: card-set manifest for scope wave-c-expanded (schemaVersion ranking_v3_dispatch_cards_v2; baselineCommit frozen; dispatchCommit + dispatchTreeSha256 bound; prerequisiteReceipts; cards[])
next generator DD present but nondispatchable until the current scope's gate receipt exists
security_boundaries: Dispatch authority comes only from the latest unrevoked card-set manifest; a new manifest revokes only overlapping unexecuted cards
Next generator DD is nondispatchable until the current scope gate receipt exists — prevents meta-dispatch deadlock
No executing agent chooses a CLI argument or discovers a file; all arguments come from named prerequisite receipts
overlap_with: FT-G1 (R1.0B/R1.6 contract covers the same §7.4 CLI shape; this card extends it to later wave boundaries)
contract.instructions:
READ-ONLY fleshing-out of the dispatch contract for boundary generator DC1 (scope wave-c-expanded, next DD). Exact §7.4 command shape:
node scripts/verify-ranking-v3-rebase.mjs snapshot-tree --head "$DISPATCH_COMMIT" --out "$TASK_OUTPUT/DISPATCH_TREE.json"
node scripts/ranking-v3-dispatch-cards.mjs build --scope "$SCOPE_ID" --baseline-commit "$BASELINE_COMMIT" --dispatch-commit "$DISPATCH_COMMIT" --dispatch-tree-manifest "$DISPATCH_TREE_MANIFEST" --qualification-target "$QUALIFICATION_TARGET_OR_NONE" --contract-seal "$CONTRACT_SEAL_OR_NONE" --task-graph "$TASK_GRAPH_OR_NONE" --expansion-receipts "$EXPANSION_RECEIPT_INDEX" --previous-manifest "$PREVIOUS_CARD_MANIFEST_OR_NONE" --include-next-generator "$NEXT_GENERATOR_ID_OR_NONE" --out "$CARD_SET_DIR"
node scripts/ranking-v3-dispatch-cards.mjs verify --manifest "$CARD_SET_DIR/cards.manifest.json"
with $SCOPE_ID=wave-c-expanded and $NEXT_GENERATOR_ID_OR_NONE=DD as literals fixed by the boundary card; $DISPATCH_COMMIT is the integration HEAD named by the preceding gate receipt. Output: expanded Wave-C card set. Focused command targets future tool test files (plan-specified, unverifiable-at-base); affected command is repo-verified.
